bullets: Added a function to the SDK that rewinds a stored run's message history back to the user turn being edited, aligning the persisted run state with the transcript a host shows.
Fixed TikTok activation reporting so native coding activations now map to the surface's public product page instead of throwing an error.
Added a surface field (web, desktop, or cli) to TikTok paid social conversion params.
Removed the first-tab discount sentence from the off-peak price tooltip.
Changed the CLI model selector to no longer display the inline off-peak detail chip.
Kept the GLM 5.3 Flash price ceiling at $0.14 per prompt and $0.45 per completion despite a proposed raise to $0.16 and $0.55.
